mission: Convert qualified demand into profitable revenue through rigorous discovery, clear recommendations, strong proposals, and disciplined closing, while owning expansion and renewal sales and handing every closed engagement cleanly into delivery.
capacity: All activity logged in HubSpot within 24 hours, every week; next step and date documented on every active opportunity. Flag Grant and Savannah in advance if pipeline coverage falls under 3x target or a forecast is trending off.

kpis.name: 1. New Contracted Revenue
kpis.calculation: Total new contracted revenue Closed Won during the month

kpis.name: 2. Close Rate
kpis.calculation: Qualified sales opportunities Closed Won ÷ total qualified sales opportunities decided

kpis.name: 3. Pipeline Coverage
kpis.calculation: Active qualified pipeline value ÷ monthly revenue target

kpis.name: 4. Sales Cycle Length
kpis.calculation: Median days from first Closer meeting to Closed Won/Lost

kpis.name: 5. Expansion & Renewal Execution
kpis.calculation: Qualified expansion opportunities with commercial next step within 2 business days; contracts approaching renewal with documented commercial next step ≥60 days before expiration

outcomes.howMeasured: Close ≥$105,000 in new contracted revenue per month
≥20% of qualified sales opportunities convert to Closed Won
Maintain ≥3x monthly sales target in qualified active pipeline
Median sales cycle ≤21 days from first Closer meeting to Closed Won/Lost; proposals delivered ≤3 business days after completed discovery

100% of qualified expansion opportunities receive a documented commercial next step within 2 business days; 100% of contracts approaching renewal have a documented commercial next step ≥60 days before contract end
Month-end closed revenue is within ±10% of forecast submitted at mid-month
100% of new business, expansion, and renewal opportunities have required fields completed by stage; Next Step and Next Step Date on every active opportunity; activity logged within 24h

100% of Closed Won engagements include signed SOW, final scope, pricing, timeline, stakeholders, discovery context, and promises made, transferred to the appropriate delivery owner within 2 business days of signature

competencies.body: Commercial judgment across new business, expansion, and renewal.

values.label: Build-Sharpen-Scale.
values.body: Turns winning discovery questions, proposals, objection responses, and closing strategies into reusable sales assets that improve future performance.

values.label: Passion for Modern Solutions.
values.body: Understands GPC's AI and automation capabilities well enough to sell business outcomes rather than technology features.

values.label: Empathetic Ownership.
values.body: Owns the quality of the revenue being sold, including whether GPC can successfully deliver what was promised.

values.label: Be Decent, Be Direct.
values.body: Sets expectations plainly, asks hard budget and decision questions directly, says no to poor-fit work, and documents commitments clearly.
